title: July 2026 Cumulative Updates for Dynamics 365 Business Central
summary: July 2026 cumulative updates are available for Dynamics 365 Business Central across multiple release waves (28.3, 27.9, and 26.15). Online customers will be automatically upgraded to version 28.3 and should verify compatibility with customizations before applying updates.
key_points: Three cumulative updates released for different release waves and versions
Online customers automatically upgrade to version 28.3 with email notification
On-premises customers must manually apply updates after confirming readiness
Partners should help assess implementation compatibility before upgrading

quotes.text: Online customers will automatically be upgraded to version 28.3 over the coming days/weeks
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that online customers receive automatic updates without manual intervention

quotes.text: Before applying the updates, you should confirm that your implementation is ready for the upgrade and ensure compatibility with your modifications.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the critical pre-upgrade validation needed to avoid breaking customizations
